# MEDIA-TARDS

> A creative digital growth studio that turns overlooked local businesses into the obvious choice in their market.

## About

MEDIA-TARDS is a boutique digital growth studio founded by three collegiate builders — Ishan, Aryan, and Kabir. We specialise in high-performance custom websites, social media management, and paid lead generation for ambitious local businesses.

We operate on a direct-to-founders model: no account managers, no junior hand-offs. Every project is handled personally by the founding partners.

Our core philosophy is the Discover → Trust → Convert framework — ensuring that target customers find the business, build trust, and take action.

## Services

- Complete Website Pack — professionally designed websites built and launched for local businesses, including responsive design, WhatsApp integration, contact forms, Google Maps, basic SEO, and mobile optimisation. Starting from ₹7,999 (one-time).
- Full Social Media Management — strategy, content calendar, creative posts, reels, captions, hashtags, scheduling, community management, and monthly analytics. Starting from ₹5,999/month.
- Marketing + Lead Generation Ads — Meta Ads management, audience research, ad creatives, lead forms, WhatsApp lead integration, tracking, retargeting, and monthly reporting. Starting from ₹4,999/month (ad spend is separate).
